visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian female main character with brown hair, glasses, and a pink button-up shirt speaks directly into a handheld camera in a bright, sunlit urban square. Behind her is a grand, historical building with classical architecture and arched windows. (2) A close-up shot transitions to show the left cheek and eye of a fair-skinned person with several visible red acne spots. (3) The main character is seen walking through a busy shopping street with light-colored cobblestones, gesturing with her hands while speaking. Numerous shoppers and storefronts like 'Arket' are in the background. (4) A brief graphic overlay appears with a circular frame containing the main character smiling against a black background. (5) She continues walking through the European street, passing by modern shops like 'PDPaola' and tram tracks. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (6) An extreme close-up graphic shows two fingers squeezing an inflamed pimple on a person's face. (7) The woman continues her walk and talk, using broad hand gestures to emphasize her points while passing a 'Retail to let' sign. (8) The video concludes with a static end card featuring the 'DRX Dermatology Clinic' logo, a QR code, social media handles, and location addresses in Taiwan on a clean white background.
